scope: Recomputed, content-bound tone release evidence bundle
validated_behaviors: Agreement, comparison, calibration, operations and security gates are recomputed from frozen source artifacts.
Every report must use the same dataset version and exact candidate test run.
Agreement, calibration and operations must share the test denominator.
The deterministic bundle ID binds dataset, run, calibration-input and operations-manifest SHA-256 values.
Any failed prerequisite keeps evidence readiness closed.
Evidence readiness remains separate from an authorized human release decision.
known_boundary: This assembles release evidence only. It does not constitute approval, enable valid tone publication, call a model, change the database or deploy production.
